content.title: Who Is Rory McIlroy's Wife? All About Erica Stoll and Her Relationship with the Pro Golfer
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll got married in 2017They welcomed their daughter, Poppy Kennedy, in 2020McIlroy filed for divorce in May 2024, but the couple reconciled a month later Rory McIlroy's wife, Erica Stoll, is his No. 1 fan. On Sunday, April 12, the golfer won the 2026 Masters Tournament, where his wife was on hand to support him. After his feat, McIlroy picked up the couple's daughter, Poppy Kennedy, and then shared a celebratory hug and kiss with his wife. The Northern Ireland native first met Stoll at the Ryder Cup in 2012. They got married in 2017 and welcomed their daughter three years later. In May 2024, the pair hit a rough patch when the professional golfer filed for divorce from Stoll. One month later, however, he announced they'd decided to stay together. So, who is Rory McIlroy's wife? Here's everything to know about Erica Stoll and her relationship with the golf star. She's from New York Erica Stoll celebrates with Rory McIlroy after he won both the TOUR Championship and the FedEx Cup title in 2016. Kevin C. Cox/Getty Stoll is originally from Irondequoit, N.Y., and was an avid tennis player in high school, according to the Democrat and Chronicle. After high school, Stoll enrolled at the Rochester Institute of Technology and graduated with a degree in marketing in 2008. In May 2023, Rory returned to Stoll's hometown to play in the PGA Championship at Oak Hill Country Club. "It's nice to come back to somewhere that you're familiar with," McIlroy told WHAM-TV ahead of the tournament. "You've got really good memories and sort of good karma." She used to work for the PGA Rory McIlroy celebrates with Erica Stoll after winning the Arnold Palmer Invitational in 2018. Stephen M. Dowell/Orlando Sentinel/Tribune News Service via Getty Stoll previously worked for the PGA of America — a job she knew she wanted straight out of college. "The way PGA employees present themselves is so admirable and professional. That's the kind of job I want, and it's doing something I love," she told the Democrat and Chronicle in 2008. During her time with the organization, Stoll served as an office manager and the manager of championship volunteer operations. She first met Mcllroy in 2012 at the Ryder Cup Erica Stoll and Rory McIlroy attend the 2016 Ryder Cup. David Cannon/Getty Stoll met McIlroy in 2012 at the Ryder Cup, where she had been working as a PGA transport official. After McIlroy overslept due to a time zone mixup and nearly missed his tee time, Stoll got him a police escort to the course in Medinah, Ill. McIlory recalled first meeting Stoll during an interview on the Golf Channel. "Erica that week was always the one that was checking us in and out. She was there at transportation, so she was always in the car park over there. But yeah, it's still cool to look around and think about that week, and obviously everything that's happened since then. It's pretty cool," he said. Related Stories Over the years, Stoll has been a steadfast supporter of McIlroy at the Ryder Cup. Most recently, she attended the 2025 event in New York, where she endured comments from a rowdy crowd, which her husband called unacceptable. "I think golf should be held to a higher standard than what was seen out there this week," McIlroy said during a press conference following Team Europe's victory. "Golf has the ability to unite people. It teaches you etiquette. It teaches you how to respect people. This week, we didn’t see that." She and McIlroy were just friends at first Rory McIlroy celebrates with Erica Stoll after winning the DP World Tour Golf Championship in 2015. KARIM SAHIB/AFP via Getty Stoll and McIlroy became friends after their initial meeting, but things didn't turn romantic until 2014. The golf pro had been dating tennis player Caroline Wozniacki when he first met Stoll. McIlroy and Wozniacki got engaged on New Year's Eve in 2013 but broke things off a few months later. Stoll and McIlroy officially started dating in late 2014, but the two kept their relationship quiet and didn't make many public appearances as a couple at the start. In May 2015, McIlroy spoke to the Times of London about his new romance. At the time, he and Stoll had been dating for a little more than six months. "I am very happy in my love life. We haven't really been putting it out there. She is from America, which is why I like to spend time in Palm Beach ... The past six or seven months have been really nice. That part of my life is going great," McIlroy said. McIlroy proposed to her in Paris Erica Stoll and Rory McIlroy attend the 2023 Ryder Cup gala dinner. Ross Kinnaird/Getty McIlroy wanted to propose to Stoll in Paris, though the 2015 terrorist attack in the city nearly caused the golfer to cancel the trip. "We had planned to go to Paris since May, we were always going to go. Then what happened made us unsure what we were going to do. So we decided to go and if we didn't like it, if we didn't like the mood of the place, didn't feel comfortable, we would go somewhere else," he told the Independent at the time. After arriving, however, McIlroy decided to go through with his proposal as planned. "We felt comfortable but I still thought at least at the start of the trip, it might make the rest of the trip even better. So we went out for dinner and that was that. It was a nice trip, a nice way to end the year," he recalled. She and McIlroy got married in 2017 Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll. Rory McIlroy Instagram On April 22, 2017, Stoll and McIlroy exchanged vows during a lavish ceremony at Ashford Castle in County Mayo, Ireland. According to E! News, the wedding had very tight security and included several A-list celebrity guests from Stevie Wonder to actor Jamie Dornan. She stays out of the spotlight Erica Stoll and Rory McIlroy at the 2025 Ryder Cup. Vaughn Ridley/Sportsfile via Getty Shortly after getting engaged, McIlroy spoke about Stoll's desire to stay out of the spotlight during an interview with the Irish Independent. "Erica has been around me quite a lot at tournaments, but we have really just tried to keep it low-key. She is a very low-key person, not the kind to broadcast stuff," he told the outlet. Although there was plenty of buzz surrounding McIlroy and Stoll's 2017 wedding, the two managed to keep the details quiet. "He's obviously one of the world's best golfers and a huge celebrity in Ireland, but Erica very much keeps herself to herself and she's not into being out there at all and I think that's the way they wanted to keep the wedding, so fair play to them," professional golfer Shane Lowry told the Irish Independent of the couple's nuptials. Full Swing — a Netflix docuseries starring McIlroy — premiered in February 2023. But the pro golfer only agreed to participate in the project after production agreed to his filming stipulations. "I made sure that the parameters were very much like, look, you can film me at — you're not coming to my house, you're not coming in my car, you're not coming anywhere near my family, but you want to do some stuff with me at golf tournaments, totally fine," he told the Golf Channel. She became a mom in August 2020 Rory McIlroy with his wife, Erica Stoll, and their daughter, Poppy, after winning the 2025 Amgen Irish Open Golf Championship. Ramsey Cardy/Sportsfile via Getty Stoll and McIlroy were able to keep the news of their pregnancy a secret for several months. In fact, McIlroy didn't confirm that they were expecting a baby until Stoll was well into her third trimester. "We're about to be parents very soon, so we're obviously super excited. Yeah, we've been sharing the news with friends and family, obviously, but I didn't think it was something that I really particularly needed to share out here. It's a private matter, but we're really excited and can't wait for her to get here," McIlroy said during a post-round interview on NBC, per Golfweek. Stoll gave birth to daughter Poppy Kennedy McIlroy on Aug. 31, 2020, in Jupiter, Fla. McIlroy announced the news on Instagram and shared a black-and-white photo of Poppy clutching his pinky finger. He captioned it, "She is the absolute love of our lives. Mother and baby are doing great. Massive thank you to all the staff at Jupiter Medical Center and Dr Sasha Melendy for their amazing care." In April 2023, Stoll and Poppy served as caddies for McIlroy at the Masters Par 3 Contest in Augusta, Ga. "Always one of the best days of the year," the pro golfer captioned a video on Instagram, which included several cute clips of McIlroy playing with Poppy on the green. In July of that same year, Stoll supported McIlroy at the Scottish Open — but it seemed Poppy was rooting for another golfer. In a video posted on X, the mother and daughter greeted McIlroy after he won the tournament. "Say 'Well done, Dada,' " Stoll told her daughter in the clip. However, Poppy wiggled out of her mother's arms as Stoll explained, "She wants to give Tommy a hug," referring to competitor Tommy Fleetwood. McIlroy filed for divorce in May 2024 but called it off one month later Erica Stoll and Rory McIlroy at the 2025 Ryder Cup. David Cannon/Getty According to court documents obtained by PEOPLE, McIlroy filed for divorce from Stoll on May 13, 2024, in Florida. However, on June 11, 2024, his attorney filed a notice of voluntary dismissal in Palm Beach County Court. McIlroy explained the decision in an interview with The Guardian the same day of his attorney's filing. “Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning," he said. She witnessed McIlroy become a Masters champion Rory McIlroy with his daughter, Poppy, and his wife, Erica Stoll, after winning the 2025 Masters. Richard Heathcote/Getty Stoll and daughter Poppy supported McIlroy at the 2025 Masters Tournament in Augusta. Before the tournament, the family of three participated in the annual Par 3 contest (where Poppy made an impressive putt!). On April 13, 2025, Stoll stood by the 18th green to watch McIlroy secure a victory over Justin Rose. The win was historic for McIlroy as he became only one of six professional golfers to win a career Grand Slam.
